## Overview

This notebook assigns GPRA benchmark tiers to each MHSP and SBMH grantee under the
**1-GPRA threshold rule**: a grantee is elevated to a higher tier (Tier 2 or Tier 3)
if **at least 1** GPRA measure falls below the benchmark cutoff. Compare to
`02_IPR_GPRA_Benchmark_2Threshold.Rmd`, which requires at least 2 measures.

**Tier definitions** (based on actual as a percentage of target):

| Tier | Criterion |
|------|-----------|
| Tier 1 | >= 75% of target (on track) |
| Tier 2 | 50-74% of target (needs attention) |
| Tier 3 | < 50% of target, or missing data (priority support) |

**Overall tier rule (1-threshold):** if any single GPRA measure is Tier 2 or Tier 3,
the grantee's overall tier is the worst (highest-numbered) tier observed.

## 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("R/helpers.R")
load_packages(c("readxl", "tidyverse", "writexl", "knitr"))
```

## 2. Import and Clean

This section mirrors the cleaning steps in `01_IPR_Aggregated_Data.Rmd`.
See that notebook for full annotations.

```{r import-clean, warning=FALSE}
mhsp <- import_ipr_sheet("data/REVISED_MHSP_IPR_Synthetic.xlsx") |>
  deduplicate_grants(id_col = "Grant ID") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 1A Target (Raw)", "gpra_1a_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 1A Actual (Raw)", "gpra_1a_actual") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 1B Target (Raw)", "gpra_1b_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 1B Actual (Raw)", "gpra_1b_actual") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 2A Target (Raw)", "gpra_2a_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 2A Actual (Raw)", "gpra_2a_actual") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 2B Target (Raw)", "gpra_2b_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 2B Actual (Raw)", "gpra_2b_actual") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 3A Target (Raw)", "gpra_3a_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 3A Actual (Raw)", "gpra_3a_actual") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 3B Target (Raw)", "gpra_3b_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 3B Actual (Raw)", "gpra_3b_actual") |>
  standardize_names()

sbmh <- import_ipr_sheet("data/REVISED_SBMH_IPR_Synthetic.xlsx") |>
  deduplicate_grants(id_col = "Grant ID") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 1 (Hired) Target (Raw)",        "gpra_1_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 1 (Hired) Actual (Raw)",         "gpra_1_actual") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 2 (Retention) Target (Raw)",    "gpra_2_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 2 (Retention) Actual (Raw)",    "gpra_2_actual") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 4 (Attrition) Target (Raw)",    "gpra_4_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 4 (Attrition) Actual (Raw)",    "gpra_4_actual") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 5 (Students Served) Target (Raw)", "gpra_5_target") |>
  clean_gpra_col("GPRA 5 (Students Served) Actual (Raw)", "gpra_5_actual") |>
  rename(gpra_3_target = `GPRA 3 (Ratio) Target`,
         gpra_3_actual = `GPRA 3 (Ratio) Actual`) |>
  standardize_names()

# Convert SBMH GPRA 3 ratios to decimals for tier comparison
sbmh <- sbmh |>
  mutate(
    gpra3_target_decimal = ratio_to_decimal(gpra3_target),
    gpra3_actual_decimal = ratio_to_decimal(gpra3_actual)
  )

cat("MHSP:", nrow(mhsp), "grantees | SBMH:", nrow(sbmh), "grantees\n")
```

---

## 3. Revision Tiers

Before benchmark tiers, assign a revision tier to each grantee based on their
follow-up and revision status.

```{r revision-tiers}
mhsp <- mhsp |>
  mutate(revision_tier = case_when(
    followup_needed == TRUE & revised == TRUE & is.na(conf_email_needed) ~ "Tier 2",
    conf_email_needed == TRUE                                            ~ "Tier 1",
    followup_needed == TRUE & is.na(revised) & is.na(conf_email_needed) ~ "Tier 3",
    TRUE                                                                 ~ NA_character_
  ))

sbmh <- sbmh |>
  mutate(revision_tier = case_when(
    followup_needed == TRUE & revised == TRUE & is.na(conf_email_needed) ~ "Tier 2",
    conf_email_needed == TRUE                                            ~ "Tier 1",
    followup_needed == TRUE & is.na(revised) & is.na(conf_email_needed) ~ "Tier 3",
    TRUE                                                                 ~ NA_character_
  ))

bind_rows(
  mhsp |> count(revision_tier) |> mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1), Program = "MHSP"),
  sbmh |> count(revision_tier) |> mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1), Program = "SBMH")
) |> kable(format = "html", caption = "Revision Tier Distribution")
```

---

## 4. GPRA Benchmark Tiers -- 1-Threshold Rule

Under the 1-threshold rule, `assign_overall_tier()` is called with
`tiers_required = 1`: any single off-track GPRA measure elevates the grantee.

```{r benchmark-tiers-sbmh}
sbmh <- sbmh |>
  mutate(across(c(gpra1_actual, gpra1_target, gpra2_actual, gpra2_target,
                  gpra3_actual_decimal, gpra3_target_decimal,
                  gpra4_actual, gpra4_target, gpra5_actual, gpra5_target),
                as.numeric),
         gpra1_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra1_actual, gpra1_target),
         gpra2_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra2_actual, gpra2_target),
         gpra3_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra3_actual_decimal, gpra3_target_decimal),
         gpra4_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra4_actual, gpra4_target),
         gpra5_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra5_actual, gpra5_target)) |>
  mutate(
    overall_tier_num = pmap_dbl(
      list(gpra1_tier, gpra2_tier, gpra3_tier, gpra4_tier, gpra5_tier),
      \(...) assign_overall_tier(..., tiers_required = 1)   # 1-threshold
    ),
    benchmark_tier = case_when(
      overall_tier_num == 3 ~ "Tier 3",
      overall_tier_num == 2 ~ "Tier 2",
      overall_tier_num == 1 ~ "Tier 1",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r benchmark-tiers-mhsp}
mhsp <- mhsp |>
  mutate(across(c(gpra1_a_actual, gpra1_a_target, gpra1_b_actual, gpra1_b_target,
                  gpra2_a_actual, gpra2_a_target, gpra2_b_actual, gpra2_b_target,
                  gpra3_a_actual, gpra3_a_target, gpra3_b_actual, gpra3_b_target),
                as.numeric),
         gpra1_a_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra1_a_actual, gpra1_a_target),
         gpra1_b_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra1_b_actual, gpra1_b_target),
         gpra2_a_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra2_a_actual, gpra2_a_target),
         gpra2_b_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra2_b_actual, gpra2_b_target),
         gpra3_a_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra3_a_actual, gpra3_a_target),
         gpra3_b_tier = mapply(benchmark_tier, gpra3_b_actual, gpra3_b_target)) |>
  mutate(
    overall_tier_num = pmap_dbl(
      list(gpra1_a_tier, gpra1_b_tier, gpra2_a_tier, gpra2_b_tier,
           gpra3_a_tier, gpra3_b_tier),
      \(...) assign_overall_tier(..., tiers_required = 1)   # 1-threshold
    ),
    benchmark_tier = case_when(
      overall_tier_num == 3 ~ "Tier 3",
      overall_tier_num == 2 ~ "Tier 2",
      overall_tier_num == 1 ~ "Tier 1",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

## 5. Tier Distribution Results

```{r tier-results}
cat("SBMH Benchmark Tier Distribution (1-Threshold):\n")
sbmh |> count(benchmark_tier) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) |>
  kable(format = "html")

cat("\nMHSP Benchmark Tier Distribution (1-Threshold):\n")
mhsp |> count(benchmark_tier) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) |>
  kable(format = "html")
```

### Per-GPRA Tier Distributions

```{r gpra-tier-breakdown}
tier_cols_sbmh <- c("gpra1_tier","gpra2_tier","gpra3_tier","gpra4_tier","gpra5_tier")
lapply(tier_cols_sbmh, \(col) {
  sbmh |> count(!!sym(col)) |> mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1), gpra = col)
}) |> bind_rows() |> kable(format = "html", caption = "SBMH Per-GPRA Tier Breakdown")

tier_cols_mhsp <- c("gpra1_a_tier","gpra1_b_tier","gpra2_a_tier","gpra2_b_tier",
                    "gpra3_a_tier","gpra3_b_tier")
lapply(tier_cols_mhsp, \(col) {
  mhsp |> count(!!sym(col)) |> mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1), gpra = col)
}) |> bind_rows() |> kable(format = "html", caption = "MHSP Per-GPRA Tier Breakdown")
```
